advice: 17 % more wing area or 14 % less weight.

requirements.why: spread-wing belly-landing speed on grass after a hand / bungee launch: <= 45 km/h (fpv_wing and drone_foldable_wings limit; Darkwing-1 50 km/h); MH 45 at Re 200 000
requirements.detail: 2215 g, 20.00 dm², CLmax 1.050 (0.9 x mh45 clmax 1.185 (Re 200,000) x cos(10.2 deg quarter-chord sweep)), sea level
advice: Stall speed goes as sqrt(weight / wing area): 8 % more wing area, or 8 % less weight, brings it from 47 to 45 km/h. Flaps or a higher-lift airfoil also work.

requirements.why: hand launch with a confident climb: T/W >= 1/(L/D) 0.125 + climb gradient 0.3 (4.5 m/s at 15 m/s) = 0.43, x ~1.35 for a 7 in FPV prop's static-to-flight thrust drop = 0.58, rounded up to 0.8 for a hand launch without the bungee

requirements.why: 12+ min of MIXED flying (the brief): level cruise at 55 km/h must last >= 20 min on 80 % of the pack; the mix 40 % cruise, 25 % half swept at 2x cruise power, 15 % climbs at ~4x, 20 % dives at idle averages ~1.65x cruise power, so 20 min of cruise = ~12 min mixed (DESIGN.md "Flight time")
requirements.detail: cruise flight time (min): 1800 mAh x 0.8 usable / 5.539 A (cruise: 92.2 W = 2215.4 g x 55 km/h / L/D 8 / eta 0.45)
advice: It runs 15.6 min of the 20 wanted: about 28 % more battery capacity (a bit more, since the heavier pack draws more), or cut the average current: lighter build, efficient props, lower-draw electronics.
